examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the site places it: the region overline, the headline and lead over the world map, four claim chips, and a floor of four client outcomes with their marks. A band with no title renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Variants
examples.summary: The three floors stacked: `outcomes` closes the band with four client quotes on one column each, `benefits` with three benefit topics in one row, and `stats` with four headline figures; the stats band also keeps one claim to wider screens (`mobile: false`) and carries an anchor. The map, title, lead and claims above are the same in all three.

examples.name: Columns
examples.summary: The `outcomes` floor takes one column per entry, two at least and four at most: two, three and four outcomes. The `benefits` floor balances up to three columns: three benefits fill one row, four split 2 × 2.

site.name: ClientQuotes
site.summary: Four client outcomes on the floor, each a quote with its figure highlighted and signed by the client logo; Dafiti and Fourbank are drawn in one ink that follows the theme.

site.name: Benefits
site.summary: Three network benefits on the floor, one topic each, in one row of three.
